title: Crafting non-OOC IP chatbots only needs a fandom link.
author: Otherwise_Cap_9408
selftext:
Many anime fans always try to create chatbots of their favorite anime characters using various AI chat tools. But there are two major challenges they would keep running into: lack of patience and professional skills to precisely describe the characteristics of the characters. 

But recently, a [Character Assistant](https://www.rpggo.ai/game/GK7NV97T8) just combined Chatbot with AI search together, making this process more efficient and less demanding. 

The only thing users need to do is to provide the character name and its fandom link to AI, then use the information summarized by it to make an IP chatbot. 

This greatly lowers the barrier to fanart creation, allowing more IP enthusiasts to focus more on creativity rather than building the basic traits of characters.

[How to cope with the Character Assistant](https://preview.redd.it/q7h9cxrblbee1.png?width=994&format=png&auto=webp&s=a4574807fe061a398b113891948bde85a0611c8d)

[The information searched and summarized by Character Assistant](https://preview.redd.it/yiy5dj2flbee1.png?width=994&format=png&auto=webp&s=d3289f51ce4cc6408243519d1fd9c0df6a510e2d)

[A non-OOC chatbot is crafted](https://preview.redd.it/zohgx8lrlbee1.png?width=990&format=png&auto=webp&s=4eba9f5d5b6761e56a65a8e22e323172d359cb55)
